player_prompt.intro:
Nyewe nye Aɖaŋu {player_id} le JoJoJoin, wodzrana ɖe tábalo 5x5 dzi kple woƒe akpa si woŋlɔ 0-24.
Le woƒe ga me, tsɔ woƒe aɖaŋu ɖe akpa bubu si mele o, abe '[12]' ene.
NYE WÓNA le woƒe aɖaŋu evelia ɖe tɔdzi — evelia akpa ene si woŋlɔ tɔdzi, dzadza, alo diagonal.
Le Aɖaŋu {player_id} nye wo, wo nye '{symbol}'; woƒe kpekpeɖe nye '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mɔnu si dzi woazã nuŋɔŋlɔa ɖo la mesɔ o.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} menye xɔxɔdɔ o. Ele be wòanɔ 0 kple 24 domee.

game_action.placed: Dodzikpɔla {player_id} da na ŋkɔ ({symbol}) le cellule {cell}.
